comment: Lectures were entertaining and only OB class without a final exam, instead students complete a final project for a local small business that provides great experience. Found studying for the midterms to be difficult with the number of vocab terms but overall was a solid class.
Took her Spring 2026 and she was amazing, let students make up their lower of the two midterms with the higher midterm grade. No final, real work consulting experience.

I would say definitely take her if you want to learn the material; if you are looking for an easy A, do not. She is very smart but her grading criteria are confusing. She was very effective in stimulating my interest for OB and that has been beneficial in my job search. One of my favorite professors but might not be everyone's cup of tea.

Probably the worst choice of professor for OB, which is unfortunate since she cares about the material. Unclear grading criteria and shifting requirements for assignments mean that I would never willingly take her again. Also, the final project was completely unrelated to course material.
we did not have to take the final which was a plus. Do not take this class though, she is very harsh and demanding. my buddies took other professors and their classes were much easier

Professor Astakhova is a very sweet person. Piggybacking off of previous responses, her grading criteria is unclear. For your final presentation, you are graded as a group, not on individual public speaking like in most courses. Try to avoid this professor if possible, especially if you have anxiety

Would not recommend this professor. The amount of work and tough expectations make it feel impossible. Participation is a large part of the grade so if you're an anxious person she's definitely not for you.

I ended up doing well in her course, but it was very difficult to do so. You must participate three times per class to receive a good grade.  She also ends the course with a project pertaining to nothing you will learn about in the course. She appears very nice, but is very tough in her expectations. I recommend choosing a different professor

her class is a miserable experience. She is well versed in the material, but is clearly trying to make the course more difficult than necessary. Participation is worth 30% of your grade, and you must speak multiple times per class. As someone with anxiety, this class is especially stressful.

Participate heavily or she will hurt your grade. Generally speaking Dr. Astakhova seems friendly but is very particular when grading and gives overly harsh feedback. Before this class, my GPA was above a 3.9. Not anymore! So don't think your grade won't suffer from this "easy" class.

I wasn't a fan of the class. Personality and leadership topics were interesting, but not much else. Graded harshly on homework, the mid-term, and group assignments. Feedback given was decent but never seemed to justify the grade received. On the positive side, this professor cares for her students and makes time out of the class to meet.

Thought OB was going to be boring but she made in interesting. Super caring and kind professor- wants to get to know her students. Some reading and need to participate in class for full credit. There's a semester-long group project but the deliverables along the way make it manageable.
